reviews.reasoning: v2 fixes both v1 faults. It is now ONE continuous rounded tray with no divider seam, so the 'same tray, different fit' claim reads immediately. The left stack of machined blocks is clearly taller than the rim while the single right-hand block sits with generous clear floor around it. No text. Saturation at >0.25 fell from 37.1% to 10.4%, so it no longer competes with the page's semantic colour.

v2 corrects the brightness failure: mean luminance dropped 0.603 -> 0.169 and saturation is now effectively zero, so it sits inside the near-black page instead of glowing out of it. The grid remains regular and countable with roughly one tile in four visibly chipped, misaligned or duller, which is exactly the '~3 characters in 4 correct' thesis. No text.

v1 was CUT for literal garbled text ('50296624 pi3efs', '1118223'). v2 has ZERO text anywhere - verified twice by independent vision passes. It now shows three plates with genuinely distinct finishes (raw brushed grey, frosted matte, polished reflective) plus a visibly empty recessed slot behind them, which is the graded-evidence-with-a-missing-benchmark idea. Saturation dropped to 0.2% at >0.25.

summary: After one re-render round, all three images PASS and are usable, replacing the earlier set in which one was CUT and two failed. The re-renders fixed a divider-seam misread, a 13x brightness clash against the dark page, and - most importantly - eliminated garbled generated text from a report whose thesis is distrust of generated figures.
